mcp_server.description: A shared remote MCP server. Entity identity and tool display names are separate.

owner.description: The person who configured this server; hosted discovery and calls use only their own definition and credentials.

name.description: Display name; normalized into a readable local tool namespace.

url.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint without embedded credentials; with `machine`, its path on that machine's own server.

machine.description: The entity whose tunnel (`tunnel{id, service, adopted}`) reaches the machine this server runs on, a space on a hosting platform. The server is then asked through that tunnel with no sign-in, and only for the tunnel's owner; absent for a server on the public internet.

enabled.description: False disables discovery; omission enables it.

allow.description: Optional JSON array of exact remote tool names; [] exposes none.
